subject: Parachute: POC kickoff — scheduling + success criteria
body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@heliodata.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed windows and attendees

Hi Priya —

Great to be moving this forward. Would HelioData be available for a 90-minute POC kickoff the week of June 7? Proposed windows below (PT):

- Tue 2027-06-08: 09:00–10:30
- Wed 2027-06-09: 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2027-06-10: 11:00–12:30

Attendees we suggest: Aditya (AE, Redwood), Soojin (SE, Redwood), Mina (Customer Success), HelioData: Priya (Lead Engineer), Samir (Security), procurement@heliodata.com

Kickoff goals / success criteria (high level):
- Confirm success criteria and roles (owner for each acceptance test)
- Walkthrough POC scope and timeline (2-week POC with demo on day 10)
- Validate network and security gating items (allowlist, certificate plan)
- Agree on data slices and test prompts for quality baseline

I'll attach a short mutual action plan and a checklist to make the meeting efficient. If none of the windows work, send a few alternatives and Soojin will surface blockers.

Thanks —
Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: 20270530_Helio_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

-----Original Message-----
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@heliodata.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@heliodata.com>, procurement@heliodata.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows and attendees

Thanks Aditya —

Appreciate the options. Procurement has a standing monthly review on Tue morning, so Tue 06/08 is out for Samir and procurement. We also have an internal SEC review on Thu morning that may pull Samir for part of 06/10. Can we aim for Wed 06/09 13:00 PT? That looks best for engineering and procurement.

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can the kickoff be trimmed to 60 minutes? We want a targeted scoping session rather than a full demo.
2) Can you include a short section (10 mins) dedicated to security gating (network, logs, encryption) with Samir present?

Priya
Principal Engineer, HelioData
HelioData Inc.

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@heliodata.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 01:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows and attendees

Priya / team —

Thanks for the quick note and for narrowing windows. We can absolutely make the kickoff a focused 60-minute scoping session. Proposal: Wed 2027-06-09 13:00–14:00 PT with the following agenda:

1) 13:00–13:10 — Intros and POC objectives (Aditya / Priya)
2) 13:10–13:25 — POC scope & timeline (Soojin)
3) 13:25–13:35 — Security gating items (Soojin + Samir)
4) 13:35–13:50 — Data & acceptance criteria (Mina + Priya)
5) 13:50–14:00 — Next steps, action owners, calendar invites (Aditya)

Soojin, please confirm the proposed agenda and call out any pre-reqs we should surface prior to the kickoff (e.g., allowlist IPs, test dataset access, Bastion details). I've attached a 1-page POC checklist (redwood-poc-checklist.pdf) and the mutual action plan for you to review ahead of time.

Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (pdf)

-----Original Message-----
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@heliodata.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 02:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows and attendees

Priya —

Confirmed on my side for Wed 06/09 13:00 PT, 60 minutes works great. Pre-reqs and gating items to highlight for the calendar invite and pre-read:
- Allowlist IPs: please provide the CIDR(s) we should add (SE will provide outbound IPs)
- Minimal dataset: a 100–200 record extract and a single sample prompt set for baseline quality checks
- Network: will this run in your VPC or do you want hosted routing? If VPC, we need a short network diagram and a contact for VPN/Bastion setup
- Security: Samir, if you can confirm logging and retention expectations we will add that to the acceptance criteria

I will demo the POC flow but will keep it light — the goal is to lock owners and acceptance tests so the POC engineer can start day 1.

Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: procurement@heliodata.com
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@heliodata.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@heliodata.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows and attendees

Mina / Aditya —

We can do Wed 06/09 13:00 PT but procurement will dial in only for the first 15 minutes. Please include high level licensing and trial terms in the meeting notes.

procurement@heliodata.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@heliodata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, procurement@heliodata.com
Cc: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@heliodata.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed windows and attendees

Sounds good — locking Wed 06/09 13:00–14:00 PT. I have calendar invite for all, Samir will join for the security block and procurement will be present first 15 mins.

Priya
Principal Engineer | HelioData Inc.
